Hi team — quick weekly nudge on Q2 commit: please finish the small set of asks below by EOD Tuesday so finance can lock numbers on Wednesday. I’m booking short slots next week to finalize any disputed closes.

Action checklist (priority order):
1) Mark each opportunity in SFDC with final Stage + Commit (Hot/Warm/At-Risk). Use the attached Q2_forecast_template.xlsx for any manual notes.
2) Upload evidence (contract LOI, SOC-2 excerpt, PO intent) to the shared folder linked below and add the file name into the SFDC evidence field.
3) If you need a 15-minute alignment slot, add yourself to my Calendly (link below) — I’ll prioritize accounts tagged ACME-XL and deals >$150k.

Notes on Acme Consulting (ACME-Q2-EXPAND-42):
- Ben: they’re asking to move the start from July 1 -> July 15; please confirm whether that impacts commit or recognition.
- Procurement looped in on contract timeline — Elena, Samir, copying you here to confirm the planned PO cadence.

Attachments: Q2_forecast_template.xlsx
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ForecastPacket | https://calendly.com/redwood/15min-commit-slot?month=2027-06

Thanks — short and sharp. If you hit a blocker reply-all with the one-line ask.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
